recommended_action.description:
Recommendation 1: Add a prepay bundle edit for 59510 that denies or recoups overlapping 59425, 59426, 59430, 59514, or 59515 billed for the same pregnancy under the same TIN or on overlapping claims/already paid claims, with separate payment only for 'partial care only' or when the 'full package not provided'. Exempt: partial care only, full package not provided. Peer: BCBS_TX, Cigna, Horizon, Moda, Point32Health, Premera, and Regence all pair 59510 with component codes 59425, 59426, 59430, 59514, and/or 59515 and treat the episode as one maternity package unless split care applies..

Recommendation 2: Adopt a cesarean assistant-surgeon edit that allows modifiers 80, 81, 82, or AS only on 59514, 59515, 59620, or 59622 on the 'assistant surgeon claim line' and caps payment at 'maximum one assistant surgeon'; do not allow assistant-surgeon modifiers on 59510 global claims. Peer: BCBS_TX, Medica, and Moda confine assistant surgeon billing to cesarean codes using 80, 81, 82, or AS and Moda caps it at 'maximum one assistant surgeon'..

IA — Implement a pregnancy-limit edit for 59510 and 59430 so only one 59510 is paid 'once per pregnancy' and 59430 is limited to the '90-day postpartum period' for the same pregnancy and same TIN. Horizon limits maternity to '1 global maternity payment per pregnancy,' Regence limits to 'one global code per pregnancy,' and Point32Health limits postpartum follow-up to 'once within 90 days'..
